ReqSite.description: Optional. The partner site the rating is requested for, for example finquest. Leave empty when you call for yourself.

error.description: Machine-readable code, such as invalid_api_key, insufficient_credits or package_not_allowed.

lane.description: On limit refusals: the setting that governs the limit that was hit.

limit.description: On limit refusals: the value that was hit.

catag.description: On per-category limits: the category tag.

tier.description: On per-category limits: the package tier of the caller.

Symbols.description: Comma-separated ticker symbols. Returns articles that mention any of them.

Industries.description: Comma-separated topics. Returns articles filed under any of them.

Categories.description: Comma-separated category slugs, as returned by the news categories endpoints. Returns articles filed under any of them.

KeyCodes.description: Comma-separated source key codes. Returns articles from any of those sources.

StmGte.description: Lowest article sentiment to include. Allowed values: Negative, Neutral, Positive.

StmLte.description: Highest article sentiment to include. Allowed values: Negative, Neutral, Positive.

PublishedAfter.description: Return only articles published at or after this time (ISO 8601, UTC).

Search.description: Text to find in article titles and body text.

cond.description: How the search triplets in srchBy combine: and, or, all or in.

pageSize.description: Rows per page, from 1 to 100. Default 100.

draw.description: Optional client counter that is echoed back with the paging result.

sortBy.description: Sort pairs. Each pair is a field name and asc or desc, for example [["published","desc"]].

srchBy.description: Search triplets. Each is a field name, a comparison operator and a value, combined using cond.

include.description: Optional field names to include in each returned row.

srch.description: Raw filter document. Prefer the typed filters of the endpoint.

sort.description: Raw sort document. Prefer sortBy pairs.

pageOff.description: Zero-based row offset of the selected page, calculated from pageNo and pageSize.

resCount.description: Result count used by paging responses.
